card.title: 573rd RIFLES
card.text: Destruction: Add two 16th RIFLES to your support line.
card.flavorText: The 573rd Rifle Regiment served as part of the 195th Rifle Division, a unit of the Soviet Red Army which saw extensive combat throughout WWII. Initially formed in the Kiev Special Military District in 1941, the division was destroyed during the encirclement at Kyiv that same year in September. A new 195th Division was formed in December 1941, this time in the South Ural region, and included the 573rd Rifle Regiment as one of its core units. This reformed division first saw major action in Operation Little Saturn in late 1942, where it helped breach the Italian 8th Army lines along the Don River. It then took part in Operation Gallop, pushing into the Donbas before being stalled by German counterattacks. The 195th later participated in the Third Battle of Kharkov, and during the summer of 1943 helped liberate areas of eastern Ukraine, including Dniprodzerzhynsk (present-day Kamianske), for which it received the Order of the Red Banner. In 1944, the division advanced through Ukraine into Romania and Bulgaria, engaging in several key offensives and helping encircle German forces during the Second Jassy–Kishinev Offensive. After the war, it served as part of the occupation forces in Bulgaria until it was disbanded in 1946.
